[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Projects[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing `n` on Admin Center ▸ Projects opens a beautiful [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]three-stage New Project wizard (Source › Configure › Review). The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]user picks a provider, then either adds a repository SASE ranks as [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]likely (local clones, unregistered repos in their GitHub owners, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]linked repos, disabled projects) or creates a brand-new repository [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]through the provider plugin with every `gh repo create` option [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reachable. The project is registered enabled, set up so agents can [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]launch in it, and ends on a Ready screen. The same behavior ships [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]as `sase project suggest | add | create`, the CLI every frontend [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shares.[/#D7D7AF]
